name: non-functional-test-planning
description: Plan non-functional tests for performance + security. Performance: load / stress / soak / spike / scalability profiles, workload modeling, SLO-aligned thresholds, baseline-vs-regression, tooling (k6 / Gatling / Locust / JMeter). Security: SAST + SCA + DAST + IAST + container + IaC scanning, penetration testing cadence, authN / authZ test cases, secret scanning, dependency-risk (vulnerabilities + licenses), threat-model coverage check. Hand-offs to test-strategy + test-data + threat-modeling. Not a certified audit. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
